arxiv-2009-04931.title: The energy-dependent π + ​ π + ​ π + \pi^{+}\pi^{+}\pi^{+} scattering amplitude from QCD Preprint: CERN-TH-2020-147, JLAB-THY-20-3242
arxiv-2009-04931.creator: Maxwell T. Hansen, Raul A. Briceño, Robert G. Edwards, Christopher E. Thomas, David J. Wilson, for the Hadron Spectrum Collaboration
arxiv-2009-04931.description: Abstract Focusing on three-pion states with maximal isospin ( π + ​ π + ​ π + \pi^{+}\pi^{+}\pi^{+} ), we present the first non-perturbative determination of an energy-dependent three-hadron scattering amplitude from first-principles QCD. The calculation combines finite-volume three-hadron energies, extracted using numerical lattice QCD, with a relativistic finite-volume formalism, required to interpret the results.

arxiv-2105-02998.title: Abelian varieties not isogenous to Jacobians over global fields
arxiv-2105-02998.creator: Ananth N. Shankar and Jacob Tsimerman
arxiv-2105-02998.description: Abstract . We prove the existence of abelian varieties not isogenous to Jacobians over characterstic p p function fields. Our methods involve studying the action of degree p p Hecke operators on hypersymmetric points, as well as their effect on the formal neighborhoods using Serre-Tate co-ordinates.

arxiv-2209-14121.title: The proportion of triangles in a class of anisotropic Poisson line tessellations
arxiv-2209-14121.creator: Nils Heerten, Julia Krecklenberg, Christoph Thäle
arxiv-2209-14121.description: Abstract Stationary Poisson processes of lines in the plane are studied whose directional distributions are concentrated on k ≥ 3 k\geq 3 equally spread directions. The random lines of such processes decompose the plane into a collection of random polygons, which form a so-called Poisson line tessellation.

arxiv-2302-12712.title: Amortised Invariance Learning for Contrastive Self-Supervision
arxiv-2302-12712.creator: Ruchika Chavhan, Henry Gouk, Jan Stuehmer, Calum Heggan, Mehrdad Yaghoobi, Timothy Hospedales
arxiv-2302-12712.description: Abstract Contrastive self-supervised learning methods famously produce high quality transferable representations by learning invariances to different data augmentations. Invariances established during pre-training can be interpreted as strong inductive biases. However these may or may not be helpful, depending on if they match the invariance requirements of downstream tasks or not.

arxiv-2303-14016.title: The GALAH survey: New diffuse interstellar bands found in residuals of 872,000 stellar spectra 2022 The GALAH survey: New diffuse interstellar bands found in residuals of 872,000 stellar spectra – 11
arxiv-2303-14016.creator: Rok Vogrinčič, Janez Kos, Tomaž Zwitter, Gregor Traven, Kevin L. Beeson, Klemen Čotar, Ulisse Munari, Sven Buder, Sarah L. Martell, Geraint F. Lewis, Gayandhi M De Silva, Michael R. Hayden, Joss Bland-Hawthorn, Valentina D’Orazi
arxiv-2303-14016.description: Abstract We use more than 872,000 mid-to-high resolution (R ∼ \sim 20,000) spectra of stars from the GALAH survey to discern the spectra of diffuse interstellar bands (DIBs). We use four windows with the wavelength range from 4718 to 4903, 5649 to 5873, 6481 to 6739, and 7590 to 7890 Å, giving a total coverage of 967 Å.

arxiv-2307-00893.title: Generating Reliable Pixel-Level Labels for Source Free Domain Adaptation
arxiv-2307-00893.creator: Gabriel Tjio, Ping Liu*, Yawei Luo, Chee Keong Kwoh, Joey Zhou Tianyi
arxiv-2307-00893.description: Abstract This work addresses the challenging domain adaptation setting in which knowledge from the labelled source domain dataset is available only from the pretrained black-box segmentation model. The pretrained model’s predictions for the target domain images are noisy because of the distributional differences between the source domain data and the target domain data.

arxiv-2405-09107.title: Unidirectional spin waves measured using propagating spin wave spectroscopy
arxiv-2405-09107.creator: G. Y. Thiancourt, S. M. Ngom, N. Bardou, T. Devolder
arxiv-2405-09107.description: Abstract The dispersion relation of spin waves can vary monotonically about the center of the Brillouin zone, allowing zero-momentum wavepackets to flow unidirectionally, which is of interest for applications. Techniques such as propagating spin wave spectroscopy are inoperative in such cases because of the difficulty to identify the spin wave wavevector at a particular frequency within a spectrum.

arxiv-2406-18241.title: Rebuttal of Morris’ criticism of the diffusive compressible Euler model
arxiv-2406-18241.creator: Magnus Svärd
arxiv-2406-18241.description:
A 2024 arXiv research paper by Magnus Svärd. This short note addresses the criticism of the diffusive compressible Euler model regarding heat diffusion, sound attenuation and material frame indifference put forward by M. 1
The model

The diffusive compressible Euler (dcE) model (previously Eulerian model) is given by,

\displaystyle\partial_{t}\rho+\nabla\cdot(\rho{\bf v})

\displaystyle=\nabla\cdot(\nu\nabla\rho),

(1a)

\displaystyle\partial_{t}(\rho{\bf v})+\nabla\cdot(\rho{\bf v}\otimes{\bf v})+\nabla p

\displaystyle=\nabla\cdot(\nu\nabla\rho{\bf v}),\qquad t\in[0,\mathcal{T}]

(1b)

\displaystyle\partial_{t}(E)+\nabla\cdot(E{\bf v}+p{\bf v})

\displaystyle=\nabla\cdot(\nu\nabla E)+\nabla\cdot(\kappa_{T}\nabla T),

(1c)

\displaystyle p

\displaystyle=\rho RT,\quad\textrm{ideal gas law,}

(1d)

where
\rho,\rho{\bf v},E,p,T
are density, momentum, total energy, pressure and temperature.

arxiv-2508-09424.title: The Enhancement of Ion Heating in Kinetic, Anti-Parallel Reconnection in the Presence of a Flow Shear
arxiv-2508-09424.creator: Colby C. Haggerty, Derek Sikorski, Michael A. Shay, Tai D. Phan, Paul A Cassak, Giulia Murtas, Prayash S. Pyakurel
arxiv-2508-09424.description: Abstract We investigate the kinetic effects of upstream, magnetic field-aligned, flow shear on anti-parallel magnetic reconnection using 2.5D Particle-In-Cell simulations. Our results demonstrate that flow shear significantly alters the reconnection process, leading to enhanced ion heating, reduced outflow speeds, and a modified reconnection geometry.

arxiv-2601-10583.title: Combinatorial Optimization Augmented Machine Learning Technical Foundations, Applications, and Research Frontiers
arxiv-2601-10583.creator: Maximilian Schiffer, Heiko Hoppe, Yue Su, Louis Bouvier, Axel Parmentier
arxiv-2601-10583.description: Abstract Combinatorial optimization augmented machine learning (COAML) has recently emerged as a powerful paradigm for integrating predictive models with combinatorial decision-making. By embedding combinatorial optimization oracles into learning pipelines, COAML enables the construction of policies that are both data-driven and feasibility-preserving, bridging the traditions of machine learning, operations research, and stochastic optimization.

pmc-10716154.title: Associations of tissue damage induced inflammatory plasticity in masseter muscle with the resolution of chronic myalgia
pmc-10716154.creator: Karen A. Lindquist, Sergey A. Shein, Anahit H. Hovhannisyan, Jennifer Mecklenburg, Yi Zou, Zhao Lai, Alexei V. Tumanov, Armen N. Akopian
pmc-10716154.description: Gene plasticity during myogenous temporomandibular disorder (TMDM) development is largely unknown. TMDM could be modeled by intramuscular inflammation or tissue damage. To model inflammation induced TMDM we injected complete Freund’s adjuvant (CFA) into masseter muscle (MM). To model tissue damage induced TMDM we injected extracellular matrix degrading collagenase type 2 (Col). CFA and Col produced distinct myalgia development trajectories.

pmc-11491461.title: The effects of oil adjuvant on the degradation of spirotetramat and its metabolites in apple cultivation
pmc-11491461.creator: Andrea Lentola, Werner Rizzolli, Thomas Facchini, Andrea Rivelli, Davide Refosco, Urban Spitaler
pmc-11491461.description: Spirotetramat is a frequently used insecticide in integrated pest management (IPM) strategies against rosy apple aphid (Dysaphis plantaginea) and woolly apple aphid (Eriosoma lanigerum) in apple cultivation. It is known that paraffin oil adjuvants increase the effect of spirotetramat against aphids.

pmc-11645291.title: A Comparative Analysis of the Efficacy of Blood Exchange Therapy in Neonatal Hyperbilirubinemia Induced by ABO and Rh Incompatibility
pmc-11645291.creator: Kunhai Wu, Lufei Chen, Huifang Huang, Dengkai Chen
pmc-11645291.description: BackgroundThis study challenges the prevailing view that hemolytic diseases of the newborn (HDN) associated with the Rh blood group system are more severe than those caused by the ABO system. The objective was to assess the effectiveness of exchange transfusion (ET) in managing HDN, with a focus on comparing treatment outcomes between ABO and Rh incompatibility cases.

pmc-12575540.title: HypoxamiRs in pancreatic cancer: master regulators of the hypoxic tumor microenvironment
pmc-12575540.creator: Pooria Salehi-Sangani, Amir Hosein Maharati, Bahareh Payami, Mohsen Aliakbarian, Mohammad Reza Abbaszadegan
pmc-12575540.description: Pancreatic cancer (PC) is characterized by aggressive progression, chemoresistance, and immune evasion, largely driven by its hypoxic tumor microenvironment (TME). The extensive desmoplastic reaction in PC, characterized by dense stromal fibrosis, exacerbates hypoxia by impairing blood flow, creating a hostile environment that limits therapeutic efficacy.

pmc-12723400.title: ﻿Molecular and morphological insights into Phaeoceros himalayensis (Notothyladaceae) and related species: evidence for two new species from Thailand
pmc-12723400.creator: Orawanya Suwanmala, Juan Carlos Villarreal A, Sahut Chantanaorrapint
pmc-12723400.description: ﻿AbstractThe hornwort genus Phaeoceros is morphologically diverse, particularly in sporophyte and spore characters. Among its members, P. himalayensis and P. kashyapii, two previously known species from the Himalayan region, are distinct in their stalked tuber thalli, dark brown sporophytes with valves apically adherent at maturity, and vermiculate spores with or without hump-like projections or verrucae on the distal face.

pmc-12733207.title: Vitamin K Epoxide Reductase Complex Subunit 1 (VKORC1) Gene Polymorphisms Predict Arterial Stiffness and Serum MGP Levels in Chronic Kidney Disease Patients
pmc-12733207.creator: David H Chen, Cees Vermeer, John R Cockcroft, David C Wheeler, Kevin M O’Shaughnessy, Yasmin
pmc-12733207.description: Background/Objectives: Arterial stiffness increases with progressive worsening of renal function and predicts cardiovascular mortality in patients with chronic kidney disease. The effects of vitamin K-dependent proteins in vascular health and the implications of vitamin K epoxide reductase gene (VKORC1) polymorphisms in calcification and warfarin sensitivity are well known, but their roles in arterial stiffness are not known.

pmc-12734479.title: Multi-Omics Characterization of a Novel SSR4 Variant in Congenital Disorders of Glycosylation
pmc-12734479.creator: Nurulamin Abu Bakar, Nurul Izzati Hamzan, Elyssa Milus Majawit, Siti Nurwani Ahmad Ridzuan, Noor Hafizah Hassan, Anasufiza Habib, Lock-Hock Ngu
pmc-12734479.description: Background: Congenital disorders of glycosylation (CDG) are rare inborn errors of metabolism with multisystemic manifestations. SSR4-CDG is an ultra-rare X-linked subtype caused by pathogenic variants in SSR4, a component of the translocon-associated protein (TRAP) complex essential for protein translocation and N-glycosylation.

pmc-13014969.title: Factors associated with changes in opioid analgesic prescribing after opioid agonist treatment initiation: A nationwide registry cohort study
pmc-13014969.creator: Gabriela Rolova, Svetlana Skurtveit, Anne Bukten, Ingvild Odsbu, Desiree Eide
pmc-13014969.description: BackgroundPain is common among individuals receiving opioid agonist treatment (OAT). This study aims to investigate factors associated with changes in opioid analgesic dispensing among treatment-naïve patients initiating OAT.MethodsWe analyzed nationwide health and dispensing records of patients initiating OAT (N = 3783) in Norway from 2014 to 2023. The cohort included new OAT patients who completed their first year of treatment.

pmc-13114049.title: Liposomal Piceatannol Mitigates Methotrexate-Induced Oxidative Renal Injury via Modulation of Nrf2/HO-1, TLR4/NF-κB, MAPK, and Apoptotic Pathways in Rats
pmc-13114049.creator: Fahad Alshammari, Ekramy M. Elmorsy, Abdulrahman S. Aldaghmi, Fahd Alaajam, Ahmed S. Shams, Gehad E. Elshopakey, Manal S. Fawzy, Nora Hosny
pmc-13114049.description: Methotrexate (MTX) is a widely used chemotherapeutic and immunosuppressive agent, but its clinical utility is limited by oxidative stress-mediated renal toxicity. This study evaluated the nephroprotective potential of the dietary polyphenolic bioactive molecule piceatannol (PIC) in its crude and liposomal nanoparticle (PIC-LNP) forms against MTX-induced kidney injury in rats.

pmc-13421433.title: Systemic and mucosal immunity to enterotoxigenic Escherichia coli: evidence from natural infection and vaccination
pmc-13421433.creator: Cynthia Mubanga, Masauso Moses Phiri, Kapambwe Mwape, Dhvani Kuntwala, Kachana Chaloba, Mutale Mubanga, Mofya Phiri, Caroline Chisenga, Roma Chilengi, Richard H. Glashoff
pmc-13421433.description: Enterotoxigenic Escherichia coli (ETEC) is a major contributor to diarrheal morbidity and mortality, especially among children under 5 years of age in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs). Development of an effective ETEC vaccine has been impeded by the pathogen’s antigenic complexity and lack of well-defined immune correlates of protection.

pmc-13605082.title: Ectopic Expression of AhDef1 Gene (Peanut Defensin Gene) Reveals Enhanced Fungal Resistance and Aflatoxin Suppression in Peanut (Arachis hypogaea L.)
pmc-13605082.creator: Nirmala Kumari Gupta, Jaykumar Patel, Gohil Mrunaliniba Yuvrajsinh, Saif Syed, Deepesh Khandwal, Avinash Mishra
pmc-13605082.description: The aim of the present study is functional characterization of a native plant defensin gene (AhDef1) from Arachis hypogaea (peanut). Further its potential has been evaluated to enhance resistance against Aspergillus flavus infection and reduce aflatoxin accumulation through transgenic intervention. Transgenic peanut lines overexpressing the AhDef1 gene exhibited significantly improved resistance to A.
